data.body: Second plan-review remediation: aligned the leaf with the parent 0/1/2 outcome contract. New pauses now return benign 0 with a stable BRIDGE_PAUSED: marker; the workflow notices only that marker, while corrupt blobs return clean 1 and existing legacy gate exit behavior is unchanged. Preserved reconcile-check by explicitly retaining its early return before check_phase_gate. Defined who as repository git user.email with no fallback, paused_at as first-write UTC RFC3339, and exact metadata preservation on same-reason re-pause. Added real CLI/temp-git coverage and a five-slot surface census. This avoids silencing corruption or legacy throttles and keeps old reconcile vocabulary and pre-change blob readers functional.
